source.name: CMIP6 multi-model projections (WCRP), Pangeo / Google Cloud public dataset
source.license: CC BY 4.0 for all CMIP6 models since October 2022 (PCMDI CMIP6 Terms of Use, which supersede the older license attribute kept per model below); cite each model's institution and acknowledge WCRP CMIP6

grid.order: lat (south to north), lon (west to east); cell centres

regridding: bilinear from each model's native grid; cells next to a missing value stay missing

parts: agreement uint8 (% of models with the sign of the median)

statistics: per model mean of annual means per 20-year period; across models median, 10th and 90th percentile; a cell needs at least 3 models
agreement_rule: share of models whose change has the sign of the median; robust if >= 80% (IPCC AR6 simple approach)
caveats: Model resolution is about 1-2.5 degrees; no bias correction or downscaling.
Projections know nothing about the local trends measured by the app.
